purpose: Separate historical robot software-state evidence from evidence of independently published OTA artifacts, so archive-completeness claims do not inflate the denominator with simulator/history values.
rules: A softwareVer value proves a software state existed only when it comes from independent official-app fixture/history evidence; the current V2 API itself does not validate arbitrary softwareVer inputs.
A version becomes an archive gap only when independent OTA evidence exists (for example an API/release record, deployment metadata, exact filename/URL, or a verified live object).
Guessed filenames are never promoted to catalog records unless the remote object independently verifies as live.
sources: data/legacy-v1-firmware-catalog.json (no listed rows for these unresolved state-version strings)

external_context.independent_version_observation: A 2018 Roomba 690 owner report records software 3.2.10+32, showing that the unprefixed fixture version is not uniquely identifying evidence for an Atlantis/R111840 OTA artifact.
external_context.official_product_sku_observation: iRobot identifies R111840 as the Roomba Combo Robot Vacuum & Mop.

states.interpretation: The app fixture binds SKU R111840 to an unprefixed 3.2.10+32 software state, but does not identify a firmware platform or OTA filename. Current V2 returns no firmware recommendation, and the same version string is independently documented on older Roomba 690 hardware; do not infer a missing Atlantis OTA artifact from this fixture alone.
